title: Why can’t I redeem an available Codex usage-limit reset?
question: I have a Codex usage-limit reset that is about to expire, but attempting to use it says I have nothing to reset. How do I use the reset?
answer: Using a reset requires your remaining allowance to be below a threshold (estimated at 10% based on the automatic reset setting). Docs : If there is nothing to reset, it remains available.
